question: What were Novo Nordisk's 2025 sales and operating profit, with growth in reported DKK vs constant exchange rates, and the USD equivalent of 2025 sales?
grading: DKK figures ±0.5% (DKK millions/billions, labeled); growth rates exact to 1pp for both reported and CER; USD conversion ±3% and must state the rate and its source; fail if DKK figures labeled as USD
answer: Novo Nordisk 2025 sales were DKK 309,064 million, up 6% reported / 10% at constant exchange rates. Operating profit was DKK 127,658 million, down 1% reported / up 6% at CER. Using the Federal Reserve 2025 annual-average rate of DKK 6.6137 per USD, sales translate to approximately USD 46.7309 billion. This is an analyst translation of DKK-reported IFRS sales. [G26-E1, G26-E2]

output.answer:
Here are Novo Nordisk’s full-year **2025** financial results, based on its annual report and February 2026 earnings release:

| Metric | Full-Year 2025 | Growth in Reported DKK | Growth at Constant Exchange Rates (CER) |
|---|---|---|---|
| **Net Sales** | **DKK 309.1 billion** (DKK 309,064 m) | **+6%** | **+10%** |
| **Operating Profit** | **DKK 127.7 billion** (DKK 127,658 m) | **–1%** (–0.5% per annual report) | **+6%** |

**Key notes:**
*   **Exchange-rate drag:** Sales grew 10% in CER terms but only 6% as reported in DKK, reflecting a stronger Danish krone versus major currencies (especially the US dollar) during the year. Operating profit was flat-to-down slightly in reported DKK (+6% at CER).
*   **Transformation costs:** Operating profit in reported DKK was negatively impacted by roughly **DKK 8 billion** in one-off costs related to the company-wide restructuring; excluding those costs, operating profit would have risen about **+6% in DKK and +13% at CER**.

**USD equivalent of 2025 sales:**
Financial data aggregators (based on SEC filings) report the annual revenue at approximately **$46.8 billion** (with other sources citing roughly **$43–48 billion** depending on the exchange-rate convention used).
*Sources: Novo Nordisk Annual Report 2025 / SEC Form 20-F; NASDAQ/Globenewswire press release (3 Feb 2026); MacroTrends.*

**Sources**
*   Novo Nordisk Annual Report 2025 — [novonordisk.com/annualreport2025](https://annualreport.novonordisk.com/2025)
*   NASDAQ/Globenewswire press release, 3 February 2026 — [view.news.eu.nasdaq.com](https://view.news.eu.nasdaq.com/view?id=b355e580b928a809510a7738f28c9c420&lang=en&src=micro)
*   MacroTrends 2025 revenue — [macrotrends.net/stocks/charts/NVO/novo-nordisk/revenue](https://www.macrotrends.net/stocks/charts/NVO/novo-nordisk/revenue)
